sections.Overview of ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+: Niva Bupa’s ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ is a premium health insurance policy offering comprehensive coverage with sum insured options up to ₹1 crore. It features the "ReAssure Forever" benefit, alongside the "Booster+" benefit, which allows unused coverage to be transferred over to the next policy year (up to 5 times the base sum insured). The plan includes no room rent restrictions , coverage for daycare treatments without financial limits, and annual health check-ups. It also offers add-ons like Safeguard+ & Hospital Cash..

sections.Pros: Offers a wide range of features. Great pick if you're looking for something affordable. Insurer has a solid track record with great claim and service metrics. Offers Lock the Clock, which makes this policy stand out. You can pick any room you like, a highly valued feature. Unlimited Restoration Benefit, which adds significant value to the policy.
sections.Cons: Maternity benefits not offered, which is a notable gap. Doctor consultations are not covered, which could be a drawback for some. Need to opt add-on for doctor consultations.

sections.Add-ons of ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+: Safeguard Recommended Increase your cover in line with inflation every year, your bonus amount will not be affected if the claim is less than Rs. 50,000 in the entire year and you also get extended coverage for generally excluded items like syringes, gloves, PPE kits etc as per List I. Safeguard + Recommended Increase your cover in line with inflation every year, your bonus amount will not be affected if the claim is less than 1 Lakh in the entire year and you also get extended coverage for generally excluded items like syringes, gloves, PPE kits etc as per List I, II, III & IV. Disease Management Recommended For Hypertension & Diabetes: Pre existing disease waiting period is reduced from 3 years to 0 days. Acute Care Get unlimited tele-consultations with Doctors (General Medical Practitioners, Specialists & Super Specialists) along with coverage for pharmacy and diagnostics up to a certain limit. Hospital Cash Hospital cash benefit paid out if hospitalization is at least 2 days, with a maximum payout of ₹2000 for up to 30 days. Personal Accident Cover Paid out as a lump sum of 500% of sum insured for Accidental Death, Total Permanent Disability, Permanent Partial Disability up to a limit of ₹10000000. Aggregate Deductible Choose deductible between ₹20,000 and ₹1,00,000 and get a discount on premiums. Tiered Network Get 15% discount on premiums with 20% Co-payment for the insured members if treatment is taken in Non-Tiered Network Hospitals. Voluntary Co-Payment Choose a co-payment between 20% and 50% to reduce premiums. Room Rent Modifier Change Any Room to Single Private Room or Shared Room.
sections.Exclusions in ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+: Conditions or treatments that the policy clearly says it will not cover. Expenses related to any admission primarily for diagnostics and evaluation purposes are excluded. Diagnostic expenses not related or incidental to current diagnosis and treatment are excluded. Expenses for admission primarily for bed rest and not for treatment are excluded. Custodial care at home or in a facility for help with daily activities is excluded. Services for terminally ill individuals addressing non-medical needs are excluded. View all exclusions
sections.Specific Illness: The following illnesses are not covered under the policy for 2 years. Pancreatitis and stones in biliary and urinary system Cataract, glaucoma and retinal detachment Hyperplasia of prostate, hydrocele and spermatocele Prolapse of uterus and cervix, endometriosis/adenomyosis, fibroids, PCOD, hysterectomy (unless necessitated by malignancy), abnormal utero-vaginal bleeding Hemorrhoids, fissure, fistula or abscess of anal and rectal region View all illnesses

sections.Frequently Asked Questions: Does ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ have waiting periods? Yes. ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ imposes 3 kinds of waiting periods - 30-Day Waiting Period: Hospitalizations won’t be covered for the first 30 days of the policy unless it’s an accident. Specific Illness Waiting Period: There’s a 2-year waiting period for a list of diseases which is a mandate before you can start claiming. Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Period: There's a 3-year waiting period for any pre-existing disease you may have while buying the policy. Does ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ have room rent restrictions? No. ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ lets you stay in any room available in the hospital - Single Private Room, Share Room, Deluxe Room, etc. Does ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ offer a restoration benefit? Yes, ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ does offer a restoration benefit. Your sum insured gets reinstated back to 100% any number of times you make a claim, in a policy year. Does ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ cover AYUSH treatments? Yes. ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ does cover AYUSH Treatments. Does ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ offer a bonus? Yes. ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ offers a bonus. Every year the policy will calculate the unutilized base cover and transfer it to the next year until your cover totals 6x the base sum insured(carry forward unutilized cover up to 5x of base cover). Does ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ offer maternity benefits? No. ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ does not offer maternity benefits. Does ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ offer international coverage? No. ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ does not offer international coverage. Does ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ offer dental protection? Yes. ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ does offer dental treatments in case of injury or accidents. Does ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ offer coverage for outpatient consultations? Yes. ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ does offer Outpatient Consultations - packaged as an optional cover/add-on. How are the premiums calculated for ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+? The premiums are calculated after taking into account your age, your location (zonal), your medical condition, (any pre-existing diseases), and lifestyle habits (smoking, drinking, etc.) Can I avail myself of a discount on ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+? Yes. Niva Bupa ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ does provide a discount. The insurer offers a discount of 7.5% on the premium amount in the 2nd year if you pay for 2 year policy term in advance and an additional 15% off on the third year premium if you pay for 3 year policy term in advance. Also, there is a medical practitioner discount of 5%. The policy also provides a discount based on how healthy you are. It is calculated after taking into account the footsteps you take tracked via their mobile application. The renewal discount ranges between 2.5% to 30%. Does ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ have entry and exit restrictions? Yes. ReAssure 2.0 Platinum+ is made available for those aged between 18 years and No Limit. Yes. This policy has an entry age of 18 years with no exit age. However, it provides coverage for dependent children from the age of 3 months in a family floater plan. View all
